title: Black Widow Assassin
lines: It’s the return of a Legend.
Black Widows are the most popular series of bowling balls ever produced by Hammer, and now they’re back to bite medium to heavy oil lane conditions.
Combine that signature Widow core motion with today’s coverstocks, and you’ve got one of the TOUGHEST rolling products in the marketplace!
FACTORY FINISH 500/500/500/1000 Abralon® with Powerhouse™ Factory Finish Polish
